description.zh:
溯源水印ab流处理视频输入视频文件。

> - OSS文件/媒资的地域需要与当前IMS所在地域保持一致。
> - 提交视频溯源水印ab流作业目前仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出。
description.en:
The input video for the A/B stream forensic watermarking job.

> - The Object Storage Service (OSS) file or media asset must be in the same region where Intelligent Media Services (IMS) is deployed.
>
> - This operation supports only videos that are three minutes or longer. Using a shorter video may cause the API call to fail or produce no output.

description.zh: 水印级别，取值0/1/2，表示嵌入通道，0u，1uv，2yuv。
description.en: The watermark level, which specifies the embedding channel. Valid values: `0` (U channel), `1` (UV channels), and `2` (YUV channels).

description.zh: 溯源水印ab流处理输出OSS地址。需要注意的是，配置的是输出目录Dir。
description.en: The output location for the A/B stream job. This must be an OSS directory.

description.zh: 水印嵌入开始时间。单位：秒。
description.en: The start time for watermark embedding, in seconds.

description.zh: 水印嵌入总时间。单位：秒。
description.en: The total duration for watermark embedding, in seconds.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024个字节。
description.en: User data to include in the request. The maximum length is 1,024 bytes.

title.zh: 提交视频溯源水印ab流作业

descriptions.zh:
- 提交视频溯源水印ab流作业目前仅支持3分钟及以上视频，视频时间过短会导致接口调用失败或无输出。
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询视频溯源水印ab流作业列表](~~2862133~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- This operation supports only videos that are three minutes or longer. Submitting a job for a shorter video may cause the API call to fail or produce no output.

- This is an [asynchronous interface](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, the system returns a job ID and processes the job asynchronously. You can obtain the processing result through a callback or by [querying the list of A/B stream forensic watermarking jobs](~~2862133~~).
